notes: Each arm is materialised by eval/run.py into a fresh temporary HOME whose .claude/ is also CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Nothing else is in that config dir.
claude_md: 'kernel' writes skills/jordan/kernel.md between the jordan-kernel markers into <config>/CLAUDE.md, as install.sh does; null writes no CLAUDE.md.

hooks: true registers every hook in hooks/hooks.json in <config>/settings.json by absolute path to this repo's hooks/, except the events in hooks_skip (the kernel already arrives through CLAUDE.md, as on the plain-copy route, RULINGS R9). JORDAN_HOME points inside the run's temp dir.
ledger_on_path: true puts a link to bin/jordan-ledger in a bin/ directory prepended to PATH. Arms without it have every PATH entry that holds a jordan-ledger removed.
skill: true copies skills/jordan/ (SKILL.md, kernel.md, modules/) to <config>/skills/jordan/.

A0.description: No JORDAN: no CLAUDE.md, empty settings, no hooks, no skill.

A1.description: Kernel only: kernel block in the config dir's CLAUDE.md.

A2.description: A1 plus the hooks and the jordan-ledger CLI on PATH.

A3.description: A2 plus the jordan skill with its seven modules.
